description: Received userdata UUIDs bound to an authenticated owner and workspace. Pure identity comparison, validation and refusal classification live in the domain leaf; mutable observation of the current authenticated scope is an application API. Workflow documents and draft persistence consume this shared contract without importing remote API internals.

characterizationScenarios.name: Identity includes the received canonical UUID, owner and workspace; expected refusals retain their DOMException contract
Scope observation keeps received identity separate from mutable authentication and preserves no-ID local compatibility
Management and persistence consume only the role-correct public identity contract without granting access to unrelated internals

compatibilityPromises: No server identity is inferred from a path or graph UUID; missing userdata identity keeps ordinary local workflows unbound.
Domain consumers can import only the pure identity API; mutable scope observation remains restricted to application-compatible roles.
